officialInventory.summary: The Sistema Nacional de Áreas Protegidas (SNAP) is managed by the Instituto da Biodiversidade e das Áreas Protegidas (IBAP) under the Lei-Quadro das Áreas Protegidas (Decreto-Lei 5-A/2011, replacing Decreto-Lei 3/97). IBAP's website lists the protected areas and publishes the creation decrees (scanned Boletim Oficial pages), which were checked for the 2000, 2005, 2011 and 2017 decrees. The 6th CBD report (2019) states the SNAP covers 26.3% of the territory (~750,000 ha) with 8 protected areas plus 3 ecological corridors created by Decrees 11–15/2017. The list appears complete for state protected areas; community forests (104) are not enumerated. Note: the IBAP website (ibapgbissau.org) also carries unrelated spam blog posts, suggesting partial compromise; facts were cross-checked against the decree scans and NR6.

areas.name: Parque Nacional Marinho João Vieira e Poilão

legalStatus.text: Created by Decreto n.º 6-A/2000 of 23 August 2000 (BO n.º 34, 2.º Suplemento)

areas.notes: 49 500 ha (IBAP). Marine national park within the Bolama-Bijagós Biosphere Reserve; Ramsar site (handled separately).

areas.name: Parque Nacional das Ilhas de Orango
areas.localName: Parque Nacional do Grupo de Ilhas de Orango

legalStatus.text: Created by Decreto n.º 11/2000 (BO n.º 49, 4 December 2000)

areas.notes: 158 235 ha incl. marine sector (IBAP). The decree title reads 'Parque Nacional do Grupo de Ilhas de Orango'; IBAP calls it Decreto-lei n.º 11/2000, the gazette 'Decreto n.º 11/2000'. Within the Bolama-Bijagós Biosphere Reserve.

areas.name: Parque Natural dos Tarrafes do Rio Cacheu
areas.localName: Parque Natural dos Mangais do Rio Cacheu

legalStatus.text: Created by Decreto n.º 12/2000 (BO n.º 49, 4 December 2000)

areas.name: Parque Natural das Lagoas de Cufada

legalStatus.text: Created by Decreto n.º 13/2000 (BO n.º 49, 4 December 2000)

areas.notes: Estimated 89 000 ha (IBAP). IBAP's page dates it 'Dezembro de 2000 – Decreto 13/2000'. Ramsar site (handled separately).

areas.name: Área Marinha Protegida Comunitária das Ilhas de Formosa, Nago e Chediã (Ilhas Urok)

legalStatus.text: Created by Decreto n.º 8/2005 of 12 July 2005 (BO n.º 28, Suplemento); management plan approved by Decreto n.º 9/2005

areas.notes: 545 km² (147 km² land, 66 km² mangrove, 203 km² intertidal mudflats, 8 km² deep channels) per decree preamble and IBAP. Community-governed MPA within the Bolama-Bijagós Biosphere Reserve.

legalStatus.text: Created by Decreto n.º 14/2011 (BO n.º 8, Suplemento, 22 February 2011)

areas.name: Parque Nacional de Dulombi

legalStatus.text: Classified by Decreto n.º 13/2017 (Suplemento ao BO n.º 26, 28 June 2017)

areas.notes: 160 096 ha (decree and IBAP). Part of the Dulombi–Boé–Tchetche (DBT) complex.

areas.name: Parque Nacional de Boé

legalStatus.text: Classified by Decreto n.º 15/2017 (Suplemento ao BO n.º 26, 28 June 2017)

legalStatus.text: Classified by Decreto n.º 11/2017 (Suplemento ao BO n.º 26, 28 June 2017)

notEnumerated.reason: NR6 gives only a count (104, ~26,050 ha); no official list found.

gaps: Guinea-Bissau had not submitted a 7th CBD national report in the CBD index at time of research; the 2019 NR6 is the latest official summary.
The Reserva da Biosfera do Arquipélago Bolama-Bijagós (listed by IBAP among its areas) is a UNESCO designation handled separately and is not recorded here.
Areas are as stated by IBAP pages; decree texts for the 2000/2005/2011 areas are scans and their annex areas were not re-read in full.
The 2019 NR6 count of '8 protected areas' versus 8 park/MPA units listed here is consistent, but any area created after 2019 was not identified.
